data.content:
I sent four disputes, each after you approved it. Together they cover $94.50 in deductions. One high-value case is waiting on a document from you.

**Sent**

| Case | Amount | Win probability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| UE-tf06f | $31.20 | 90% (strong) | The ticket doesn't list the claimed Butter Chicken. The order was ready at 18:47 and picked up at 18:50. |
| UE-tf07g | $26.80 | 75% (moderate) | The ticket lists Chicken Tikka. The order was ready at 13:32 and picked up at 13:38. |
| UE-tf02b | $21.50 | 75% (moderate) | The ticket lists Lamb Biryani. The order was ready at 19:22 and picked up at 19:26. |
| UE-tf03c | $15.00 | 87% (moderate) | The ticket lists Garlic Naan. The order was ready at 20:33 and picked up at 20:36. The same customer account made 3 claims this period, and the dispute states that as a plain count only. |

- **Moderate cases:** For the moderate cases, the ticket and pickup times show the order was prepared as placed. Nothing shows what went into the bag.
- **Past results:** I have no past results for Uber Eats cases like these. The only history I have is DoorDash: two wins and one loss on a similar evidence pattern. The loss was a side item that wasn't itemised on the ticket. Treat the probabilities as estimates.

**Needs your input**
- **UE-tf01a ($52.00, the largest deduction):** This case is weak, at 30% (down from 55%). There is no order ticket on file, so I can't check the claimed Chicken Biryani (Family Size) against what was prepared. Please send a photo of the ticket for that order. I'll re-run the evidence check when it arrives.

**Not pursued**
- **UE-tf04d ($18.25, 45%) and UE-tf05e ($12.75, 55%):** These were outside the top 5, so I haven't reviewed them. I can check them if you want.
- **UE-tf08h ($9.00), UE-tf09i ($14.00, 15%) and UE-tf00z ($0.00):** I recommend skipping these. They are too small or too unlikely to win, and UE-tf00z is already past its deadline.

**Next deadline:** 2026-12-12, 28 days away. That applies to every open case, including UE-tf01a.

I saved the case notes to `/plan.md`.
